children.text: Who We Are Looking For
Anduril mobilizes across ranks for critical impact.
Whether fully discharged or approaching separation from active service, Anduril provides both Full-Time and Fellowship roles for those who are ready to rebuild the arsenal of democracy.

children.text: Full-Time Employment
From first contact to immediate impact
Marshal your military experience and tactical knowledge to shape the future of deterrence at Anduril.

As program requirements evolve in real-time, our full time opportunities scale to meet the mission. If your military experience exceeds our expectations but does not align with current Full-Time openings, join our Veteran Talent Network.
Career Simulation
Action before application
Before you apply, step inside the role. Our simulations let you demonstrate your skills and decision-making, not just talk about them.
Materials Associates
keep production moving when the mission can’t wait — solving supply chain problems fast, with whatever’s at hand.
General Technicians
build advanced defense systems from the ground up — hands-on assembly, integration and troubleshooting where precision and speed are non-negotiable.
Anduril career simulations provided by our partners at Redeployable.
SkillBridge Fellowship
Command and control your career
Commit the last 180 days of service as an Anduril SkillBridge Fellow to accelerate your post-military career.
If your active-duty experience does not align with a current SkillBridge opportunity, contact us directly as many of our Full-Time roles can be converted into Fellowships for qualified candidates.

The DoW SkillBridge program allows transitioning service members to gain civilian work experience through specific industry training, apprenticeships, or internships during their last 180 days of service.
At Anduril, we're building the future of defense, and that requires an extraordinary array of talent. You'll find SkillBridge Fellowship opportunities across many disciplines
here

.

Anduril is constantly growing and as we rapidly scale, our talent needs continuously evolve and broaden. Please note that new SkillBridge opportunities are added regularly and that many of our Full-Time Employment roles can be converted into Fellowships for qualified candidates. Be sure to contact us if you do not see a dedicated SkillBridge opportunity that fits your needs.

items.title: What type of opportunities are available?

children.text: We generally screen candidates for opportunities when they are within three months of their SkillBridge availability. Our alignment process can take anywhere from a few weeks to a couple of months. Starting your process more than three months out will be too far away from when a hiring decision can be made so target 90 days from when you can begin your Fellowship.

items.title: When should I apply for a SkillBridge Fellowship with Anduril?

children.text: Anduril SkillBridge Fellowships allow you to explore our advanced technology and mission-driven teams before beginning your terminal leave. We provide you with the experience and information necessary to make career-related decisions earlier in your transition and better prepare you for EAS/ETS.

items.title: Why pursue a SkillBridge Fellowship vs. Full-Time Employment (FTE) role?

children.text: While most Anduril SkillBridge Fellowships last 2-4 months, they can range depending on the candidate. Be sure to check the
SkillBridge website

for your eligibility requirements.

Our start dates are structured to accommodate transitioning service members throughout the entire year.

items.title: How long are Fellowships and when do they start?

children.text:
You do not need command approval before applying to an Anduril SkillBridge Fellowship; however, approval is a requirement before you begin your Fellowship with Anduril. We understand the potential challenges and delays in obtaining command approval, so we will be flexible while you wait for approvals.

We welcome applications from enlisted/officer, degreed/non-degreed, and junior/senior military candidates. Be sure to verify you meet the required qualifications listed in the job description.
Your resume is your opportunity to powerfully convey your capabilities and potential impact at Anduril. Make it compelling by including:
Clear Contact Information:
Ensure we can easily reach you.
Academic Foundations:
Military training/qualifications, University, Major(s).
Demonstrated Experience:
Highlight relevant military experience to include significant projects and deployments where you made a difference.
Clearances:
Be sure to list your current security clearance and/or ability to obtain one.
Technical Mastery:
List the languages, software, tools, and platforms you're proficient in.
Quantifiable Impact:
Whenever possible, use numbers and metrics to showcase the scale and success of your contributions.

items.title: What should I include on my resume?

children.text: We receive a significant volume of applications from highly talented individuals, which makes providing individual updates to every applicant unfeasible. We appreciate your patience as we meticulously review each submission.
If you are selected to move forward:
A member of our recruiting team will contact you directly to outline the next steps.
If the team decides to pursue other candidates or the search concludes:
You will receive an email notification informing you of our decision.

items.title: When can I expect to hear back about my application?

children.text: Our interview process is designed to be rigorous, transparent and a true test of your capabilities. Prepare for a deep dive into your technical prowess, problem-solving approach, and how you align with Anduril's mission. You can expect:
Recruiter Call:
To discuss your background and ambitions.
Technical and Behavioral Interviews:
Expect challenging questions designed to assess your skills, critical thinking, and how you navigate complex situations.
Role specific assessments:

This could include live coding challenges, presentations, or in depth technical discussions, depending on the team and role.

Throughout, we’re looking for evidence of your problem solving abilities and your commitment to our mission. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance every step of the way.

items.title: What does the interview process look like?

children.text: Throughout your Fellowship with Anduril you will be assessed for Full-Time placement, but there are no guarantees of a job offer. However, each Fellowship opportunity is aligned internally to provide a job offer if the Fellow qualifies.

items.title: Is a job offer guaranteed at the end of the fellowship?
